Team — thanks for the quick turn. I pulled the numeric scores into a consolidated row and drafted the leadership narrative (first pass) below. Please reply with inline edits or short bullets (no more than 2 sentences each) by EOD Wednesday so I can finalize for exec distribution Thursday morning.

Consolidated Q2 score (weighted avg): 0.71
Top-line narrative (draft):
Q2 delivered meaningful operational progress with material cost and latency improvements on Dedicated capacity and early wins from Redwood Optimize pilots. However, enterprise traction was partially constrained by compliance timelines and pricing complexity; remediation and pricing simplification are the primary levers entering Q3.

What moved the needle:
- Serving runtime optimizations lowered median latency by ~18% for 99th percentile workloads.
- Dedicated capacity bookings from two customers reduced host-level cost by an estimated 9% on pilot workloads.
- Optimize pilot cut token spend for three customers, validation for broader rollout.

Risks & asks:
- Compliance (SOC-2 evidence) remains gating for near-term enterprise renewals — Marcus to confirm remediation ETA.
- Pricing clarity and PLG onboarding frictions — Monica to lead a simplified tier proposal by July 22.

Open actions to include in QBR (owner / ETA):
- Marcus: SOC-2 remediation checklist + canary (2026-08-15).
- Monica: Pricing simplification deck + PLG playbook (2026-07-22).
- Laura: Consolidated scorecard + QBR deck integration (2026-07-01).

I've also created a short appendix with the one-line rationales pulled from each area and a link to the live sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Q2_okr_synthesis_doc
